class.name: CbProbe
class.brief_description: A line a motion throws along the look. The motion happens only if it finds something, and its effects can act on what it found.
class.description: A child of a [CbMotion] (one per motion; not for a While). When the motion would start, a line goes from the player's view along the look, up to [member range]. If it finds nothing, nothing happens: no cooldown, no use, no event. If it finds something (the world, a prop, another player), it flies there at [member travel], takes hold of that point, and from then the motion is on: its parameters hold and its [CbForce] and [CbLink] children act. An effect whose target is "what the probe found" acts on that body at that point; a direction "toward the target" points at it. The point stays on what it found: on a prop or a player it moves with them. When that is gone the motion ends. In conditions, [code]linked[/code] is true for a player whose probe is out. A [CbLinkLook] draws the line.

members.member: How far the line reaches, in metres.
The speed it flies at, in metres per second: it takes hold after distance / speed. 0: at once.
